name: constant_zero_returns
description: All historical returns are exactly 0.0 across all tickers. spy_today_return=0.0. current_symphony_return = 0. Distribution is degenerate (all zeros) so searchsorted returns the full length when value equals all elements (left-insertion semantics) — pin captures present behavior.
derivation: Captured behavioral pin under numpy.random.seed(42). All sim_results are 0.0; current_symphony_return = 0.01 * 100.0 * 0.0 contributions = 0.0 (last_percent_change=0.0); searchsorted 'left' on sorted-zeros for value 0.0 returns 0 (left-insertion); below_count=0; result = ((5000 - 0) / 5000) * 100.0 = 100.0. This pin protects against any sign/order swap in the searchsorted call or the simulation_paths arithmetic.
